name: Sungrow Battery
tagline: High-voltage LFP battery, expandable from 9.6 kWh to 25.6 kWh per unit.
summary: The Sungrow SBR is a high-voltage lithium iron phosphate battery built from 3.2 kWh modules. A unit holds three to eight modules, and up to four units can be connected in parallel.
Modules plug together without cables, and the battery can be extended later.

highlights.title: Strong charge rate
highlights.text: Charges and discharges continuously at up to 30 A with high efficiency.

highlights.title: Full usable energy
highlights.text: Up to 100% of the stored energy is usable.

highlights.title: LFP safety
highlights.text: Lithium iron phosphate cells with multi-stage protection and extensive safety certification.

highlights.title: Expandable later
highlights.text: Runs three to eight modules per unit, with up to four units in parallel.

highlights.title: Easy installation
highlights.text: Compact, light modules plug together with no cables between them.
